system.name: MMEvol
system.one_liner: A multimodal instruction data evolution framework: each round evolves instructions in three directions, then eliminates ineffective ones.

content.variant_note: one seed question about a room photo evolves upward through three rounds along three colour-coded evolution types; failed branches stay as dashed salmon cards
content.argues: Instruction evolution and instruction elimination working together over several rounds make image-text instructions more diverse and more complex.
content.subject: One seed lamp-counting question on a room photo evolving over three rounds into new question-answer cards, kept or eliminated.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw iterative data evolution as a vertical round axis with real example cards per round, arrow colours keyed to the type of transformation, and kept versus eliminated cards told apart by border style, tint and a True or False header; growing tree icons turn the iteration into a metaphor.
lessons.suits: Iterative data-synthesis or self-improvement pipelines with several kinds of transformation and a filtering step, where real examples can be shown at every round.

evidence: each evolution cycle consists of two main steps: instruction evolution and instruction elimination
Instruction evolution and instruction elimination synergistically collaborate through multiple rounds
one of the three evolution directions is randomly selected to transform simple instructions into more complex or diverse forms

summary: MMEvol evolves image-text instruction data for multimodal LLMs: each round applies one of three evolution types (fine-grained perception, cognitive reasoning, interaction) and then eliminates ineffective results. Figure 1 shows this on one room photo with the seed question 'How many lamps are in the image?'. A vertical axis marks Seed and Rounds 1 to 3; at each level real question-answer cards sit in rounded boxes, linked upward by blue, orange or green arrows keyed to the evolution type. Kept cards (Improved: True) have a green fade and a solid border; failed ones (Miscounted, Hallucination) are dashed and salmon with the wrong spans underlined in red. Tree icons grow from a sprout to a fruit tree and a gardener with shears marks pruning.
summary_zh: MMEvol 用多轮指令进化与淘汰提升多模态指令数据。图从一张房间照片的种子问题出发，竖轴标出种子到第 3 轮，每轮放真实问答卡，蓝橙绿箭头区分三类进化；成功卡绿底实线，失败卡红底虚线并红线标错，树的成长与园丁修剪作隐喻。
notes: The 23 bitmaps in the digest are mostly gradient card backgrounds plus the tree, gardener and evolution icons; only the room photo is a data picture. Failed cards have no children, as the paper says ineffective evolutions are eliminated. The canvas has a large blank area above the content (drawn content reaches above the canvas).
